name: Bossa Nova Civic Club
status_note: Event listings (RA via Findmuse, Mood) show nights through at least Oct 13–14, 2026. Note: the old official domain bossanovacivicclub.com now 301-redirects to an unrelated site (paddlingcenter.com), so don't link it; use RA listings instead.

dress.detail: No official or third-party source found states a dress code; reviews describe an alternative, open-minded techno crowd.

age.value: 21+ with driver's license, non-driver ID or passport

cover.value: Varies by night: free or suggested donation on some weeknights; around $15 cash reported for regular nights; RA tickets for bigger lineups

sources.name: Findmuse / RA event listing, Oct 13, 2026 (donation at door)

getting_in.value: Walk up and pay at the door; some nights sell advance tickets on Resident Advisor; bring cash

hours.value: Seven nights a week, roughly 10pm–3:30/4am (varies by event)

subway.value: Under the elevated M on Myrtle Ave; Central Av (M) is the nearby stop, ~1–3 min walk

skip_if: You want room to move: the dance floor is small and sits between the bar and the bathrooms, so traffic is constant.
You dislike heavy fog and a dark, cramped layout, which reviewers call out.
